recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞的細胞質內擠滿許多 2–4 µm 的小型卵圓形酵母菌，菌體周圍有透明暈圈（halo），並有偏心深染的核質；B 圖另以特殊染色（可能為 PAS）將菌體染成洋紅色，符合 HIV 病人的播散性組織漿菌症（histoplasmosis）。
features: Panel A (Wright-Giemsa): macrophage with foamy cytoplasm containing numerous small (2–4 µm) oval yeast forms
Yeasts show a crescent of basophilic cytoplasm/nucleus at one pole surrounded by a clear, unstained halo
Some organisms appear extracellular near the ruptured macrophage
Panel B (special stain, likely PAS): uniformly sized magenta oval yeasts clustered within and around macrophages, highlighting the cell wall
Background: granulocytic precursors, lymphocytes and red cells without other organisms
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A) shows macrophages distended by numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeasts measuring about 2–4 µm, each with a polar crescent of basophilic material surrounded by a clear halo, with a few organisms lying free. A special stain (panel B, likely PAS) highlights the yeast cell walls as magenta oval forms within and adjacent to macrophages. No kinetoplast or capsule thickening is identified. In an HIV-positive patient with a CD4 count of 47/µL, findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); urine/serum antigen and fungal culture confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a cell wall, so they are PAS/GMS negative, whereas Histoplasma yeasts have no kinetoplast and stain with PAS/GMS.
T. marneffei yeasts divide by binary fission with a central transverse septum and some elongated sausage forms, rather than narrow-based budding, in patients from Southeast Asia.
Cryptococcus is larger (4–10 µm) and more variable in size with a thick mucicarminophilic capsule and narrow-based budding.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and PAS negative, and Pneumocystis cysts are cup-shaped without intracellular budding yeast morphology.
